custom.label: Section keeps its register
custom.instruction: Each section of an issue has one way of talking. Flag a page whose register leaves its section's — a playful section turning textbook, a reference section turning chatty.

custom.label: Question hook
custom.instruction: A feature opens on a question the page then answers. Flag a feature whose first block is neither a question nor a deck ending in one.

custom.label: Three-beat section spine
custom.instruction: A section runs wonder, then how, then so-what across its pages. Flag a section whose pages do not move through those three, or that repeats one beat twice running.
